meta.title: Shohider Pran — Registry & Support for the July Uprising
meta.description: An official-record registry and support platform for the martyrs and injured of the July Mass Uprising.

home.title: The official record, and no one turned away.
home.subtitle: A registry for the martyrs and the injured of the July Uprising — matched against the government's gazette where possible, and open to everyone else the record may have missed.
home.guardrail: This platform does not decide who is a legitimate martyr or injured person. It reflects the official record, plus a clearly labelled pending-review queue for people the list may have missed.

counters.heading: The record so far
counters.source: Source: DGHS, via July Shaheed Smrity Foundation (jssfbd.com)

calendar.heading: ১ – ৩৬ জুলাই
calendar.intro: The public did not stop counting in July when the calendar did — the uprising is still remembered day by day, straight through to ৩৬ জুলাই, ৫ আগস্ট.

footer.guardrailAi: No AI agent in this system ever verifies someone's status. AI drafts, screens, and summarizes — a human approves anything that leaves the system.
footer.guardrailNumbers: Every number on this dashboard is either verified against the official record or explicitly labelled pending — never blended.

register.title: Register a martyr or injury
register.errorRequired: Please answer this question to continue.
register.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

proxy.question: Are you filling this out for your own family, or on behalf of someone else?

proxyRelationship.question: What is your relationship to them? (e.g. neighbor, community volunteer)

category.question: Are you registering a martyr or an injured person?

nid.question: Do you have their National ID or birth registration number?
nid.hint: Optional, but it makes an exact match far more likely.

guardian.question: What is their father's or spouse's name?
guardian.hint: Optional — helps us tell apart people who share a name.

result.verifiedBody: This registration matches an entry in the official gazette. It is now marked verified.
result.candidatesTitle: We found possible matches — please confirm
result.candidatesBody: These entries in the official record look similar. If one of them is who you're registering, select it to confirm. Otherwise, say none of these match and your registration stays on record as self-reported.
result.confirmCandidate: Yes, this is who I'm registering
result.notFoundTitle: No match found in the official record — you're registered anyway
result.notFoundBody: We could not find a matching entry in the official gazette right now. Your registration is saved as self-reported and will be automatically re-checked every time the gazette is updated. You can optionally upload a supporting document for a human reviewer.
result.uploadedNote: Document uploaded. A human reviewer will consider it.
result.cameraGuideHint: Line up the document within the frame, then capture
result.cameraUnsupported: Camera capture isn't available on this device/browser — please use the file picker above instead.
result.cameraPermissionDenied: Camera access was denied. Please use the file picker above instead.
result.screeningNoteLabel: AI screening note for the reviewer (advisory only — not a decision)
result.trackedStatus: You can track this registration's status any time using its ID below.
result.whatsNextBody: Verified and self-reported registrations both continue to the entitlement and support process from here — a human reviews anything that needs judgment before it moves forward.

register.switchToChat: Prefer to describe it in your own words instead?

draft.question: You have a saved, unsubmitted registration in progress.

intake.title: Tell us about them
intake.starterMessage: Hello — I'm here to help you register a martyr or an injured person from the July Uprising. Were you registering a martyr (shohid), or someone who was injured (ahoto)?
intake.unavailable: The intake assistant isn't set up right now. Please use the step-by-step form instead.
intake.errorGeneric: Something went wrong reaching the assistant. Please try again.
intake.switchToForm: Prefer a simple step-by-step form instead?

digest.title: Registry digest
digest.subtitle: A weekly, plain-language summary of registry activity for the dashboard and press — aggregate counts only, never individual names.
digest.noSummary: No summary available yet — either there are no registrations yet, or the AI summarizer (GEMINI_API_KEY) isn't configured. The counts below are still live.

stats.heading: This week, in numbers
stats.selfReported: Self-reported, not yet in the official record

followUp.title: Follow-up drafts
followUp.subtitle: Registrations still unresolved after 45 days. The AI only drafts a note — nothing is sent anywhere until an admin clicks Send.
followUp.scanResult: Found {scanned} unresolved past 45 days, drafted {drafted} new note(s).
followUp.empty: No pending follow-up drafts right now.
followUp.sentNote: This app has no outbound email/SMS integration yet — this only records that a human handled it.

stories.publicTitle: Amar Golpo — their stories, in their families' words
stories.publicSubtitle: Shared by families of registered martyrs and injured people. Translations drafted by AI are held for human review before they appear here.
stories.submitSubtitle: Write in your own words, in either Bangla or English — we'll take care of showing it in both.
stories.authorNameLabel: Your name (optional, shown as the storyteller)
stories.bodyPlaceholder: Share a memory, who they were, what they loved…
stories.submitted: Thank you for sharing. It's now visible in the language you wrote it in — a translation is being prepared and will appear once reviewed.
stories.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
stories.reviewSubtitle: AI-drafted translations only — the original text a family wrote is already visible and untouched here.

petitions.publicSubtitle: Open letters drafted from a stated cause and reviewed by a human before anyone can sign. Signing requires a real registration ID — no anonymous or inflated counts.
petitions.signErrorNotFound: We couldn't find that registration ID.
petitions.signErrorDuplicate: That registration ID has already signed this letter.
petitions.signErrorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
petitions.proposeSubtitle: Describe the cause in your own words — the AI will draft formal letter text, and an admin reviews it before anyone can sign.
petitions.titleLabel: A short title for this letter
petitions.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Faster medical compensation processing in Rangpur
petitions.askLabel: What are you asking for, and why?
petitions.askPlaceholder: Describe the situation and what you'd like the authorities to do…
petitions.submitted: Thank you — this is now with an admin for review. Once approved, it will appear on the public collective letters page for people to sign.
petitions.errorRequired: Please fill in the title, the ask, and your Registration ID.
petitions.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
petitions.reviewSubtitle: AI-drafted letter text — review before approving. Nothing here is public or signable yet.
petitions.noDraftYet: No draft yet — the AI summarizer may not be configured, or drafting failed. You can still approve using the stated cause above, or wait and retry.
